course_name: 智慧空間互動程式設計
outline:
This course integrates information visualization, interactive web programming, cloud databases, Internet of Things (IoT) technologies, smart floor sensing systems, Generative AI, and Agentic AI to develop students’ abilities in designing and implementing smart space interactive systems.
Using a project-based learning approach, students will begin with front-end web development and progressively learn JavaScript programming, Apache ECharts data visualization, Firebase cloud database integration, Arduino-based sensor data acquisition, and smart floor sensing system applications. The course further introduces Gemini API, Prompt Engineering, and Agentic AI technologies to develop Smart Space Agents capable of environmental sensing, contextual analysis, and autonomous decision-making.
The course emphasizes practical implementation and interdisciplinary integration across interaction design, information visualization, artificial intelligence, and smart space applications. Through hands-on projects, students will gain experience in developing intelligent interactive systems for smart space and smart healthcare environments.
